name: @bookmark-organizer/extension
description: Chrome extension that applies bookmark changes for the bookmark-organizer MCP server.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome134 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/background.js && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json')"
